id.description: The id canoa.cfg records as `provider`: a word of lower-case letters, digits and `_`, 1 to 32.

help.description: A line saying what it reads.

types.description: The Store types it serves, by id (`overlays`, `skills`, `mcps`, `extensions`, or a type an extension added); none means every type.

schema.description: The values its form asks for, as a guatiao schema of an object; none for a source that asks for nothing. A member the schema marks sensitive is never shown in clear. No member is called one of [`HOST_KEYS`].

form.description: How the schema is shown, a guatiao-intake form document; none shows the form the schema implies.

endpoints.description: The `https` places its `fetch` may reach: an origin (`https://host`) or a prefix with a path (`https://host/repo/`) that a URL has to start with, redirects included. None means it fetches nothing from a place of its own: an address an entry names is allowed only because the person wrote the entry.

keys.description: The fingerprints of the publisher keys it verifies what it reads with, in the publisher's own notation; none when it verifies nothing. An entry's `keys` replace them.

kind.description: The id of the Store type the catalog is of.

label.description: The label the person gave the catalog.

fields.description: What the form's fields hold, as a JSON object of what the schema's members hold, keyed by member name. A field the person left empty is absent, so the provider uses its own default.

pin.description: The entry's `pin`: a revision the source understands (a commit, a version), or `sha256:<hex>` of the catalog's text, which the host checks itself. None follows the source's upstream.

keys.description: The fingerprints the entry demands a signature from, in place of the source's own `keys`; none when it names none.
